title: Principal Research Scientist I Process Development

cond_0001.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors, Masters, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or 6+ (PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Direct experience in designing, planning and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert within the company and possibly externally
Demonstrated creative thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Interacts well with diverse groups within function and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Demonstrated ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software, ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA and mass spectrometry-based methods

cond_0022.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drugs substance purification development strategy though program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of downstream purification processes and how they connect to broader CMC development goals.
cond_0022.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams.
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0022.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors, Masters, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+(BS), 10+(MS), or 6+(PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Must be a subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Direct experience in designing, planning and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Must have excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Must have strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert in his/her discipline within the company and possibly externally
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Demonstrate creative 'out of the box' thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Interacts well with diverse groups within function and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Demonstrated ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Has proficiency with Microsoft Office software, ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA and mass spectrometry-based methods

The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drugs substance purification development strategy though program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0029.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams.
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0029.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field required; advanced degree (MS or PhD) strongly preferred, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or minimum 6 years (PhD) of demonstrated expertise in purification process development
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert in his/her discipline within the company and possibly externally
Deep subject matter expertise in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics, including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Advanced proficiency with AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain detailed written records
Extensive direct experience in designing, planning, and executing virus clearance studies
Proven track record functioning as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Demonstrated ability to apply creative, out-of-the-box thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Strong ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Exceptional communication skills, including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Proven track record as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated expertise in scientific communication and presentation, including presenting at leading scientific conferences
Strong command of Microsoft Office software and ability to learn new software applications
Advanced knowledge of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA, and mass spectrometry-based methods
Substantial direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics

The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams. People typically grow stronger in this kind of purification development work over time as they build experience across programs and learn from each stage of the process.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams.
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0149.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors, Masters, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+(BS), 10+(MS), or 6+(PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Direct experience in designing, planning and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert within the company and possibly externally
Demonstrated ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Demonstrate creative 'out of the box' thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Interacts well with diverse groups within function and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software, ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA and mass spectrometry-based methods
cond_0149.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0149.values: We value creating work that has a meaningful and positive effect on others. We believe fairness, respect, and responsibility should guide how we operate.
cond_0149.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, in cases where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to women applicants in support of our gender balance commitment.

The team leverages its end-to-end CMC capabilities through all phases of CMC development, with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role sits within a team of experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development and IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of the CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to support human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and contribute to drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0196.responsibilities:
Function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts; evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently manage project science within your area of expertise on one or more project teams
Provide input to cross-functional CMC teams on purification development strategy and contribute to project deliverables
Make significant contributions to project teams through lab-based activities
Identify and implement new tools, techniques, and strategies into individual programs and the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Coordinate with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, and regulatory filings; publish research in peer-reviewed journals and present work at scientific conferences
Work toward project timelines and goals, coordinating with relevant functions as required
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals; accountable for the effective performance of those individuals
cond_0196.requirements:
Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or 6+ (PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Recognized as a downstream process development expert within the field
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics, including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready, or similar)
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Direct experience in designing, planning, and executing virus clearance studies
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Creative problem-solving ability to address difficult technical challenges and evaluate new technologies to achieve project goals
Able to work with diverse groups within the function and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Ability to provide clear technical input across scientific disciplines
Strong written communication skills and clear, direct verbal reporting, including scientific data presentation
Experienced as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents, and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication skills, including presenting at scientific conferences
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software; ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA, and mass spectrometry-based methods
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
cond_0196.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0196.values: We value creating work that has a meaningful and positive effect on others. We believe fairness, respect, and responsibility should guide how we operate.

cond_0332.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to drive all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role sits within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.

Proactively identify and implement new tools, techniques, and strategies into individual programs as well as the overall downstream platform.

Drive progress cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals.
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals; be accountable for their effective performance.

cond_0361.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0361.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0361.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelors, Masters, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or 6+ (PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Direct experience in designing, planning and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert within the company and possibly externally
Demonstrated creative thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Interacts well with diverse groups within function and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Demonstrated ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software, ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA and mass spectrometry-based methods

cond_0384.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long and rich history of biologics development. The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.

Independently responsible for project science within your area of expertise on one or more project teams

Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual programs as well as the overall downstream platform

Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work closely with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings, including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals, staying in regular contact with team members across functions
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals and evaluate their performance; accountable for the effective performance of the team

The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to drive all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role sits within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of the CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will own all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and lead drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0440.responsibilities:
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development.
Drive original technical ideas and development strategies as a principal investigator.
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and determine appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques.
Own purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables.
Take full responsibility for project science within your area of expertise on one or more project teams.
Represent the purification development team and directly influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams.
Deliver significant contributions to the project team through lab-based activities.
Proactively identify and implement new tools, techniques, and strategies into individual programs as well as the overall downstream platform.
Execute lab and pilot scale operations hands-on to meet project deliverables.
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing.
Lead coordination with contract labs and execute viral clearance studies.
Author technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings, including peer-reviewed journal articles and scientific conference presentations.
Drive progress cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals.
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals; be accountable for their effective performance.
cond_0440.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or 6+ (PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics, including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready, or similar)
Direct experience in designing, planning, and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert within the company and possibly externally
Demonstrated creative, out-of-the-box thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Demonstrated ability to influence others across scientific disciplines
Works well with diverse groups and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents, and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA, and mass spectrometry-based methods
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software; ability to learn new software applications

cond_0484.intro:
The Biologics CMC Development team at [Company name masked] has a long history of biologics development. The team leverages its end-to-end CMC capabilities through all phases of CMC development, with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role sits within a team of experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development and IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of the CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to support human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and contribute to drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0484.responsibilities:
Function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts; evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently manage project science within your area of expertise on one or more project teams
Provide input to cross-functional CMC teams on purification development strategy and contribute to project deliverables
Make significant contributions to project teams through lab-based activities
Identify and implement new tools, techniques, and strategies into individual programs and the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Coordinate with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, and regulatory filings; publish research in peer-reviewed journals and present work at scientific conferences
Work toward project timelines and goals, coordinating with relevant functions as required
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals; accountable for the effective performance of those individuals
cond_0484.requirements:
Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+ (BS), 10+ (MS), or 6+ (PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Recognized as a downstream process development expert within the field
Subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics, including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready, or similar)
Excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Direct experience in designing, planning, and executing virus clearance studies
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Creative problem-solving ability to address difficult technical challenges and evaluate new technologies to achieve project goals
Able to work with diverse groups within the function and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Ability to provide clear technical input across scientific disciplines
Strong written communication skills and clear, direct verbal reporting, including scientific data presentation
Experienced as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents, and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication skills, including presenting at scientific conferences
Proficiency with Microsoft Office software; ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA, and mass spectrometry-based methods
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics

The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of the CMC purification development group leaders, you will bring strong expertise in CMC purification to help develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to support human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will work alongside cross-functional CMC teams, sharing responsibility for drug substance purification development strategy through program lead assignments.
cond_0540.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to generate original technical ideas and development strategies as a principal investigator
Work alongside colleagues to lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and coordinate efforts to advance them; anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies
Collaborate to conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Share accountability for purification strategy for biologic candidates and project deliverables
Contribute independently to project science within your area of expertise on one or more project teams
Represent the purification development team and work with cross-functional CMC teams to help shape development strategy
Make significant contributions to project teams through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to bring into individual programs as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and work with the team to execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Coordinate process transfers to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently and cross-functionally with colleagues toward project timelines and goals
Mentor and supervise a team of one or more individuals, evaluate their performance, and share accountability for the effective performance of the team
cond_0540.requirements:
Bachelors, Masters, or Doctorate (Ph.D.) degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, with at least 14+(BS), 10+(MS), or 6+(PhD) years of experience in purification process development
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert in his/her discipline within the company and possibly externally
Must be a subject matter expert in purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert user of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Must have excellent attention to detail and ability to keep detailed written records
Direct experience in designing, planning and executing virus clearance studies
Demonstrated ability to function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Demonstrate creative 'out of the box' thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies to achieve project goals
Interacts well with diverse groups within function and maintains strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators
Demonstrated ability to influence others across areas of scientific disciplines
Must have strong communication skills including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Experienced and demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents
Demonstrated scientific communication and presentation skills by presenting at leading scientific conferences
Has proficiency with Microsoft Office software, ability to learn new software applications
Strong understanding of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA and mass spectrometry-based methods
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics

The team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This Principal Scientist I role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel oncology drugs and successfully filed two BLAs.
As one of CMC purification development group leaders, you will apply your strong expertise in CMC purification to develop robust, phase-appropriate processes for drug substance GMP production to enable human clinical studies and eventual licensure. You will be responsible for all aspects of CMC purification program deliverables and help drive drugs substance purification development strategy though program lead assignments in cross-functional CMC teams.
cond_0578.responsibilities:
Effectively function as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Lead development, optimization, and scale-up of purification processes for biologics candidates to support early and late-stage development
Generate new scientific proposals and lead those efforts. Anticipate and critically evaluate scientific advances and respond with appropriate new strategies.
Conceive and evaluate novel advanced separation technologies and techniques
Lead purification strategy for biologic candidates and take accountability for project deliverables
Independently responsible for project science within his/her area of expertise on one or more project teams.
Represent purification development team and actively influence development strategy on cross-functional CMC teams
Make significant contributions to project team through lab-based activities
Proactively seek out new tools, techniques, and strategies to implement into individual program(s) as well as the overall downstream platform
Be hands-on and execute lab and pilot scale operations to meet project deliverables
Transfer processes to GMP manufacturing
Work with contract labs and carry out viral clearance studies
Write technical publications, reports, presentations, and regulatory filings including publishing research in peer-reviewed journals and presenting work at scientific conferences
Work efficiently, collaboratively, and cross-functionally toward project timelines and goals
Mentor/supervise a team of one or more and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals
cond_0578.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, bioengineering, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 14 years of demonstrated expertise in purification process development (BS), 10 years (MS), or 6 years (PhD).
Deep knowledge of purification of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) or other mAb-based biologics, including chromatography separations and filtration operations (depth, dead-end, virus and ultrafiltration/diafiltration)
Expert-level command of AKTA chromatographic instruments (such as AKTA Avant, AKTA Purifier, AKTA Pure, AKTA Ready or similar)
Proven track record as a principal investigator, generating original technical ideas and development strategies
Direct experience designing, planning, and executing virus clearance studies
Direct experience with execution of downstream processes at GMP and/or pilot scale for mAb or other mAb-based biologics
Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain detailed written records
Exceptional communication skills, including verbal, written, and scientific data presentation
Demonstrated success as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents, and/or primary inventor of patents
Preferred Requirements
Recognized and sought out as a downstream process development expert within the broader scientific community
Demonstrated ability to influence others across scientific disciplines
Proven ability to apply creative, out-of-the-box thinking to solve difficult technical problems and champion new technologies
Strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators across diverse groups
Demonstrated scientific communication skills through presentations at leading scientific conferences
Advanced knowledge of analytical techniques using HPLC, ELISA, and mass spectrometry-based methods
Proficiency in Microsoft Office software and ability to learn new software applications
cond_0578.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0578.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, in cases where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to women applicants in support of our gender balance commitment.
